evidence.observation: Tube pressure stable at ~3.02-3.07 Torr through ramp, then monotonic rise during growth: 3.06→3.11→3.13→3.21→3.27→3.34 Torr
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not flow-driven
Temperature holds 750 °C at ~46% heater power, control nominal
Sensor not installed; growth-stage atmosphere (leak/oxygen ingress) cannot be verified
